source: Contributed in PR #12 (verified by the contributor on a real 270416 Apple Silicon install; the installer is not publicly archived). keeptip branches from 0x46676fc to a 348-byte code cave at 0x5894af8 (source: tools/patches/wechat-270416-keeptip-self-recall.s) that keeps the real newmsgid for self recalls (你撤回/你收回/你回收/You recalled) and zeroes it otherwise. The English marker compare was fixed after merge ("You " = 0x20756f59) and checked by emulating the cave on recall XML; the earlier cave bytes are still accepted so restore and re-patching work on installs patched from the PR branch. The silent variant puts the newmsgid store, hook and cave back to pristine.

Official 4.2.0.54 installer, arm64 wechat.dylib SHA-256 9beeba8587f6b342a459e7e583d662859da2a701268787967f849f17dfc00596. The silent variant restores the original newmsgid store when switching from keeptip. The multiInstance entry is the single-instance predicate located via runningApplicationsWithBundleIdentifier: and confirmed at its startup caller. x86_64 keeptip and updater entries added from the official installer (dmg SHA-256 04933657d5c3a3445bd7c07859a7a9b7e6f3437c2e19b5df6984e3179c25b6ca) with the same method as 270388.
